messages:
ana: Heads-up — Orion Cloud just pinged: manifest update shows ~2-week lead time slip on the EU rack shipment (affects Dedicated commit for EU). Need quick allocation plan.
jess: Ugh. Do we know if partial shipments are possible? We had a small buffer from last month.
orion-cloud: Orion Cloud (partner): Confirmed — container ETD moved from 2026-04-12 -> 2026-04-26. We can split shipment: ~40% now (earliest available), 60% later. Shipping docs: https://orion.example.com/awbs/XYZ123
mike: If split is possible we should reassign capacity: 20% -> marketplace reserved pool, 20% -> priority SI onboarding. Jess, can you run quick impact numbers?
jess: On it. Quick calc: current EU dedicated commit = 120 racks. With 40% now we get ~48 racks now, ~72 later. If we move 20% (24 racks) to marketplace reserved, that buys hosted customers ~3 weeks runway.
ana: @toby FYI — PM/marketing were planning an EU Dedicated GA announcement Apr 20. This slip might force a hold or limited GA language.
toby: Can product shift announcement to May 5? Prefer not to announce partial availability. Can infra confirm final ETA by Apr 28?
mike: Suggest plan: (1) accept 40% split, (2) assign 24 racks to marketplace reserved, (3) route 24 racks to SI pilot + buffer, (4) open temporary credits for affected Reserved customers. Also ask partner to attempt expedited customs on tranche 2.
orion-cloud: We can attempt expedited customs on tranche 2 but there's an extra cost ~+$5k/container for brokerage and priority handling. Need confirmation by EOD to request from shipping carrier.
jess: Running final numbers. If we reassign 24 racks to marketplace we cover pre-sold reserved seats, but premium SI pilot loses ~12 racks — likely delays for two SI customers unless we backfill from buffer.
ana: Decision for now: approve split. Assign 24 racks -> marketplace, 12 racks -> SI pilot, 12 racks -> reserved emergency buffer. @finance-bot please confirm expedited customs approval cap.
mike: Roger. I'll update allocation matrix and notify partner before EOD. Ops snippet I'll attach here:
```alloc: { now: 48, later: 72, marketplace: 24, si_pilot: 12, buffer: 12 }```
finance-bot: finance-bot: Acknowledge. Approve expedited customs up to $20k. Please tag cost center: partnerships-eu.
ana: :thumbsup: Thanks. I'll draft comms for customers & PMs outlining limited GA and expected tranche dates. Any objections?
toby: No objections. Recommend soft-announcement to channel partners with "limited GA" language and clear callouts for impacted SI timelines.
orion-cloud: Will prep amended manifest and final AWBs and send by EOD. We'll also confirm customs expedite ETA and cost breakdown.
